title: DiTraR: Diverse Scorers and Transcript-Guided Re-ranking for Video Corpus Moment Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2611.27931v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video corpus moment retrieval asks a system to find, in a large collection of untrimmed videos with subtitles, the video and the time interval that a natural-language query describes. We find that most top-ranked errors of a strong corpus-level scorer come from choosing the wrong video, not from imprecise boundaries, and that re-weighting the evidence the scorer already uses does not fix them. We present DiTraR, which addresses video selection from two complementary directions. A witness-interval scorer decomposes the query into probes and scores every candidate interval of every corpus video exactly; a multi-scorer energy ensemble averages the energies of independently trained scorers before one exhaustive search; and a transcript verifier, a frozen language model that reads the time-stamped dialogue of the highest-ranked videos, re-orders the moments without changing their boundaries. translated_title: DiTraR：面向视频语料库时刻检索的多样化评分器与字幕引导重排序方法
translated_abstract: 视频语料库时刻检索要求系统在一个包含字幕的大型未剪辑视频集合中，找到自然语言查询所描述的视频及相应时间区间。我们发现，一个强大的语料库级评分器所产生的大多数排名靠前的错误源自选错了视频，而非时间边界不够精确，并且对评分器已使用的证据进行重新加权无法解决这些问题。我们提出了DiTraR，从两个互补的方向来解决视频选择问题：一个见证区间评分器将查询分解为探针，并精确地对语料库中每个视频的每个候选区间进行评分；一个多评分器能量集成在执行一次穷举搜索之前，对多个独立训练的评分器的能量进行平均；以及一个字幕验证器——一个冻结的语言模型，读取排名最高视频的带时间戳的对话内容——在不改变时刻边界的情况下对时刻进行重新排序。所有设置均在开发数据上冻结，并且……
tldr: 论文提出DiTraR方法，通过见证区间评分器、多评分器能量集成和基于字幕语言模型的验证重排序，从视频选择和时间区间定位两方面提升视频语料库时刻检索的准确性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes DiTraR, which improves video corpus moment retrieval by combining a witness-interval scorer, a multi-scorer energy ensemble, and a transcript-guided frozen language model verifier to address wrong-video selection errors and re-rank moments precisely.
